name: Mandi
description: Mandi is a historic commercial and spiritual hub on the banks of the Beas, famous for its ancient stone temples and artistic heritage.
history: Mandi, historically 'Mandav Nagar', is named after the sage Mandav. It was a crucial commercial hub on the ancient trade route connecting the plains to Tibet. The present district was formed in 1948 by merging the princely states of Mandi and Suket. The chiefs of these states claim descent from the Sena dynasty of Bengal (Chandravanshi Rajputs). Ajbar Sen founded Mandi Town in 1527 A.D., making it the capital. The town features over 80 stone temples, earning it the title 'Choti Kashi'. The Victoria Bridge, built in 1877, still stands as a colonial engineering heritage.
culture: Mandi is hailed as the cultural capital of the state. Its International Shivratri Fair is a grand spectacle where over 200 village deities arrive to pay respects to the presiding deity, Madho Rai (Lord Vishnu). Mandi is famous for its 'Sepu Badi' culinary heritage and traditional silver jewelry. The 'Mandiyali' dialect and a distinct style of hill painting flourished in its royal courts for centuries.

topSpots.name: Prashar Lake
topSpots.description: A high-altitude lake with a floating island and a 14th-century temple dedicated to Sage Prashar.

topSpots.name: Rewalsar Lake
topSpots.description: A sacred lake for Hindus, Buddhists, and Sikhs, known for its floating islands of reed and fish.

topSpots.name: Panchvaktra Temple
topSpots.description: An ancient temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, located at the confluence of the Beas and Suketi rivers.

topSpots.name: Janjehli Valley
topSpots.description: A trekker's paradise known for its pristine beauty and traditional wooden architecture.

cuisine.name: Sepu Badi
cuisine.description: Steamed spinach and lentil dumplings slow-cooked in a tangy yogurt-based gravy.
cuisine.history: Sepu Badi is the pinnacle of Mandyali cuisine, traditionally served as the main course in the royal Dham.
cuisine.tip: Best enjoyed with a warm bowl of ghee-laden rice during the International Mandi Shivratri mela.

wildlife.name: Himalayan Monal
wildlife.description: A magnificent bird found in the dense oak and deodar forests of the Janjehli valley.

weather.monsoon_impact: Substantial rainfall in July-August, turning the valleys lush and green
weather.packing_essentials: Cotton clothing for summer, light woolens for winter

festivals.name: International Shivratri Fair
festivals.description: A seven-day mega event where hundreds of local deities congregate.

festivals.name: Sair Festival
festivals.description: Celebrating the end of the harvest with traditional rituals and buffalo fights.

itineraries.title: Varanasi of the Hills
itineraries.description: A spiritual and scenic weekend in the historic town of Mandi.

days.title: The Floating Island
